test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All Tears are Salts.

Some Tears are Crocodiles.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Crocodiles are Tears.

II. All Crocodiles are Salts.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Statements:

All Tears are Salts.

Some Tears are Crocodiles.
